nodes.label: README / project identity and asset credits
nodes.rationale: Declares the repo as the final project for the Computer Graphics exam at Politecnico di Milano a.y. 2025-2026, and records the licence status of the two asset packs used (MGCG course pack, Dracula's Castle pack).

nodes.label: Dracula asset pack licence caveat
nodes.rationale: The itch.io pack ships no licence file and its licence field is empty, so it is used only for a non-commercial university project, with credit; the original .unitypackage is deliberately not redistributed.
